library.conflict.keep-both.outcome: Both versions are kept, as two separate saved builds.
library.conflict.cancel.outcome: Nothing is saved. The other tab's version is kept, and your version stays in this tab.
library.conflict.changed-again: The build changed again while you were deciding. Here is the version that is stored now.
library.conflict.locks-unavailable: This browser cannot coordinate between tabs, so replacing a saved build is unavailable. You can still keep both versions, or cancel.
library.manage.title: Choose builds to discard
library.manage.description: Nothing is removed until you choose it and confirm. Your open build stays as it is either way.
library.storage.summary: Roughly {{used}} of {{available}} used. Your browser decides the real limit.
